Chapter 6678: Ghost Edge

Chapter 6678: Ghost Edge

These rays resembled the first in the legends. Rivers of time appeared and so did epochs. Although Li Qiye’s rays weren’t actually the first, they started creating worlds.

They reached Three Immortals and washed away fear and anxiety, representing hope. As long as they were around, Three Immortals would be safe.

Primordial immortals or anything else, it didn’t matter. They wouldn’t be able to destroy Three Immortals.

Inhabitants could finally get up from the ground and stare at the descending rays. Once enough descended, they came together to form a primordial tree.

Powerful cultivators had an anima tree. However, Li Qiye was different. It seemed so real and mighty, even above the immortal level.

Techniques were often described as having the force of three thousand worlds. However, Li Qiye’s tree possessed an infinite number of temporal rivers and variations of three thousand worlds.

One river had three thousand worlds but he unleashed countless rivers in unison.

“This is my dao.” Li Qiye said: “As per your request, you shall get to see it before I let go.”

“Already an old dao.” Evil Transformation said.

“Yes.” Li Qiye nodded.

The tree contained everything - time, lives, fortune, worlds...

Bao Pu had two incredible dao - his founder dao and the worm dao. However, both were dust specks compared to Li Qiye’s tree.

Overlords and immortals were still ephemeral compared to the eternal tree, merely shining brighter than the others.

Bao Pu turned pale upon realizing this dao’s immensity. Most importantly, was it going to be discarded? What would the new dao be then?

Immortals would find this to be the limit. How could there be a greater height?

“This is reaching the shore?” Fiendish Ground asked.

“Even further.” Li Qiye replied.

The two opponents couldn’t help but look up at the sky. In their memories, only one existence had this potential - the high heaven.

This made them less confident in their ace card.

“It seems like we’re still struggling in the sea of suffering.” Evil Transformation sighed.

“Didn’t you find the path to reach the shore?” Li Qiye reminded.

“Yes, and it is time.” Fiendish Ground nodded solemnly.

“Now that you have seen my grand dao, it is time to use all of your primordial power.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Very well, primordial chaos traced to the source.” Evil Transformation said.

“Let’s begin!” Fiendish Ground’s roar reverberated through the present to the past, crushing everything along the way and leaving only darkness behind.

“Ghost Edge!” From this darkness came a blade.

People believed that creating a paragon artifact required the destruction of an epoch. The birth of this weapon destroyed an entire river of time.

It wasn’t that the ruined river nurtured this ghost blade. Its appearance alone was too much for the timeline to endure.
